about: Arizona county and city grant programs, entered by hand from each program's own page. Not a complete list. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: ESG and CDBG Public Service NOFA (PY2027-28)
programs.objectives: Emergency shelter and rapid rehousing for people experiencing homelessness.
programs.who: Nonprofits or nonprofit collaboratives serving people experiencing homelessness. The application form's only tax status choice is a nonprofit Arizona 501(c)(3).
programs.application: Download the application from the county's notices page and email it before 5 p.m. MST.
programs.award: About $1,816,303 in all. Paid by reimbursement; no match required.
programs.deadlines: Applications are due Tuesday, December 8, 2026, before 5 p.m. MST.

programs.title: CDBG Annual Competitive Application (PY2027-28)
programs.agency: Maricopa County Housing and Community Development Division
programs.area: Maricopa County's small towns and unincorporated areas
programs.objectives: Projects for low and moderate income people in the Maricopa Urban County: nine small towns and the unincorporated areas. This application takes no public service or operating requests.
programs.who: Eligible nonprofit agencies and organizations, which must document 501(c)(3) status, and participating local governments.
programs.application: Apply in the county's Neighborly portal by 5 p.m.
programs.award: About $1,750,000 in all. Applicants pay their own administration costs.
programs.deadlines: Applications are due Tuesday, December 8, 2026, at 5 p.m.

programs.title: HOME CHDO Funding (PY2027-28)
programs.agency: Maricopa County Housing and Community Development Division
programs.area: Maricopa County HOME communities (not Phoenix or Mesa)
programs.objectives: Affordable housing development by certified community housing development organizations, outside Phoenix and Mesa.
programs.who: Nonprofits certified as a Maricopa County Community Housing Development Organization (CHDO). An IRS determination letter confirming 501(c) tax-exempt status is required.
programs.application: Apply in the county's Neighborly portal by 5 p.m.
programs.award: About $668,000 in all. A 25% non-federal match is required for all activities. Paid by reimbursement.
programs.deadlines: Applications are due Tuesday, December 8, 2026, at 5 p.m.
